reviews.title: Absolutely zero support!!!
reviews.text: I’ve had this app on my iPhone for years. I decided to try it on the Apple Vision Pro, and it looks amazing.  I decided to purchase the lifetime subscription, but the subscription button seems to be broken on the Vision Pro. I continued to purchase the 200+ dollar subscription via iOS with no problems. Now, back on the Vision Pro, the subscription won’t sync.  I tried the support button from the App Store, which brought me to a support website.  Website, is a generous term for what amounts to a generic FAQ!  No contact us button, no email address. I’m hoping someone from support or at a minimum any of the developers will see this review and find a way to reach out.

reviews.title: Was great before made to opt for a monthly subscription
reviews.text: I bought this app when it was first released and it was fun and educational: I could point my phone in any direction and I could see planets, constellations, you name it. So I thought it would prove useful this morning when we awoke at 3:15 to view the meteor shower. I opened the app and was immediately presented with a screen for pricing tiers. Suddenly my original purchase was demoted to “base plan,” and I was shown three options with no way to exit the screen. All I wanted to do was find the right direction for where the meteor shower would present itself, but instead I was given a screen to select one of three subscription options. It would appear I am now left with an app I cannot use after having paid for it. Had Fifth Star Labs LLC thought to launch their app as a subscription model in the beginning, I wouldn’t feel like I’ve been the unsuspecting victim in a bait-and-switch. To the LLC owner(s), I hope everything you purchased switches to a monthly subscription so you, too, can experience what it feels like to be a customer who paid for your app.

reviews.title: Keeps getting less
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for a number of years. When I first got it, it was free but I paid for the upgraded version. It wasn’t a subscription. It was a one time purchase at $10. Over the years they’ve taken away more and more. And now to get the pro version of it it’s almost $300. My original purchase means nothing I get nothing extra and everyone gets what I paid for free. It’s not worth it. There are plenty of other apps that offer more rather than a subscription for a couple of features. What a letdown. The only reason it gets two stars is it still functional. Satisfaction at 1😐 if you do pay for this, they’ll just take away everything or make it basic. They don’t even have the music playing anymore.
